units: <cite ref="Yoma 67b">Yoma 67ᵇ</cite> <he>זוֹקְרוֹ בת וכ׳</he> Ar. a. Mss. M. 2 a. O. (ed. <he>זורקו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), v. <cite ref="B01378"><he>בַּת</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be thrown; to leap, to stagger. Ib. 38ᵇ, v. בַּת II.
to be decided upon, to be decreed upon.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 52b:8">Erub. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>למקום שרובו הוא נזקר</he> (Var. <he>נזד׳</he>) he is judged to belong to where the larger portion of his body is.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18a">R. Hash. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כולן נזקרין בזקירה אחת</he> Ar. (Var. Ar., a. ed. <he>נסקרין … בסקירה</he>) the fate of all of them is decided in one decree.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 46a:6">Ber. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>אל יִזְדַּקֵּר וכ׳</he> (Alf. a. oth. <he>יִזְדַּקֵּק</he>, v. <cite ref="G00652"><he>זָקַק</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) may there not occur to him (our host) or to us anything that suggests sin &c.
